issues.description: The full pipeline has 14 native input reads. Eight compatible local source routes are verified: DealScan facility/company/package/financialcovenant/currfacpricing, Worldscope stock_1 with its documented 1993+ subset, the native DSWSLINK table and Worldscope company table. Their local formats and code-consumed field/key contracts support staging preparation; complete sample, match/entity coverage and historical-vintage fidelity remain later empirical validation, not availability gates. Remaining requirements retain specific unresolved gaps, including the Worldscope fundamentals read timeout, stock_2 monthly construction, prepared ADR construction, the exact Chava–Roberts facility-GVKEY link and separate ADR event inputs. The supplied workbook contains facility identifiers only. No catalog miss is treated as absence or a licensing barrier.

The author cites the up-to-date Chava–Roberts (2008) DealScan–Compustat link; supplied code joins it on facilityid=facid and carries GVKEY. No exact local table alias or matching facility-level file contract is confirmed. The general WRDS link matrix and similarly named DealScan–Worldscope/DSWS tables are not established substitutes.

The code consumes two distinct ADR event inputs (`adr_drop` and `adr_add`) with GVKEY and datadate, then applies MMoU-relative exclusion rules. The exact event-row construction, date coverage and compatible sources are not provided or found as direct catalog aliases.

The stock-2 preparation excerpt begins a slash-star block comment and includes another slash-star delimiter inside it. SAS block comments cannot nest, so the intended status of this apparent recipe is unresolved. The active workflow still reads the separate prepared `wrds_ws_stock_2` input; do not credit the excerpt as a complete producer until its intended boundary is confirmed.
